title: Fulfillment Program Guide: Entry Conditions and Order Terms for Ridgeline Orders & Delivery
content:
A Ridgeline Orders & Delivery order is placed under exactly one fulfillment program, and each program accepts only items and addresses that meet its entry conditions.

## Entry conditions by program

| Fulfillment program | Entry conditions the item and the order must meet |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | Each item weighs no more than 150 lbs, and the delivery ZIP code is serviceable by the carrier |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | The item is in stock at the store |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | The vendor ships the item to the store |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | The item is in stock at the store, and the address is within the delivery radius |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | The address is within the delivery radius, and the site has curbside or garage access |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | The address is within the delivery radius, and the item is in the appliance category |

Where a program lists two conditions, both must hold.

## Order terms by program

| Fulfillment program | Order minimum (merchandise total) | Same-day order cutoff (local time) | Largest delivery distance from the fulfilling store | Item and quantity change window after placement | Substitution of an out-of-stock item | Tenders accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | $0.00 (none) | Not applicable | 0 miles (not applicable) | 30 minutes | Not allowed | Bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit, gift card |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | $0.00 (none) | Not applicable | 0 miles (not applicable) | 15 minutes | Allowed with the customer's consent | Bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit, gift card |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | $0.00 (none) | Not applicable | 0 miles (not applicable) | 30 minutes | Not allowed | Bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit, gift card |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | $35.00 | 14:00 | 15 miles | 15 minutes | Allowed with the customer's consent | Bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit, gift card |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | $0.00 (none) | Not applicable | 50 miles | 60 minutes | Not allowed | Bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit, gift card |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | $0.00 (none) | Not applicable | 50 miles | 60 minutes | Not allowed | Bank card, Ridgeline Consumer Credit, Ridgeline Pro Credit, gift card |

**Meaning of the columns.** The order minimum is the smallest merchandise total the program accepts; $0.00 means there is none. The same-day order cutoff is the local time by which an order must be placed for same-day delivery. The largest delivery distance is measured from the fulfilling store; 0 miles means the measure does not apply to the program. The change window is the number of minutes after the order is placed during which items or quantities can be changed. Substitution, where allowed, replaces an out-of-stock item only with the customer's consent.

## Points of judgement (illustrative inputs)

- A Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery order with a merchandise total of $34.99 is below the $35.00 order minimum; one of $35.00 meets it.
- A Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery order placed at 13:40 local time is placed by the 14:00 cutoff; one placed at 14:25 is not.
- A Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery address 38 miles from the fulfilling store is within the 50-mile distance; one 62 miles away is not. A Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery address 18 miles away is beyond its 15-mile distance.
- A Ridgeline Ship to Home order placed at 09:10 can have items changed at 09:25, which is 15 minutes after placement and inside its 30-minute window; at 09:55, 45 minutes after placement, the window has passed.
- A Ridgeline Ship to Home item weighing 150 lbs meets the weight condition; one weighing 162 lbs does not.
